acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: mabl auto-heal https://help.mabl.com/ , Testim smart locators https://help.testim.io/docs/smart-locators .

Gap: AMAP-V0-007 grades selector strength but does not detect when a template change breaks a test selector.

Proposal: report each broken selector with ranked candidate replacements from a multi-attribute fingerprint. It is proposal-only: it never auto-heals and never changes a verdict. Silent runtime auto-heal is out of scope. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: appmap: selector drift diagnosis with proposal-only candidate repairs
